build.beforeDevCommand: bun run build:agent && bun run dev:ui
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run build:agent && bun run build:ui

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'
